detail: ok: got '2026-07-29', expected '2026-07-29' | ok: got 4010.0, expected 4010.0 | ok: got 2839.0, expected 2839.0
answer:
Part A: 2026-03-19 is a Thursday. Counting weekdays from 2026-03-20 and skipping the six listed holidays, the 88th business day is 2026-07-29.

Part B: Count divisible by at least one of 3, 5, 7:
\[
\lfloor 8000/3\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/5\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/7\rfloor
-\lfloor 8000/15\rfloor-\lfloor 8000/21\rfloor-\lfloor 8000/35\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/105\rfloor = 4343
\]
Subtract those also divisible by 13:
\[
\lfloor 8000/39\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/65\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/91\rfloor
-\lfloor 8000/195\rfloor-\lfloor 8000/273\rfloor-\lfloor 8000/455\rfloor+\lfloor 8000/1365\rfloor = 333
\]
So the answer is \(4343-333=4010\).

Part C: Let \(n=17k\). Then \(17k\equiv 8\pmod{19}\), so \(k\equiv 15\pmod{19}\). Thus \(n=255+323t\). Modulo 23:
\[
255+323t \equiv 2+t \equiv 10 \pmod{23}
\]
so \(t\equiv 8\pmod{23}\). Therefore \(n=255+323(8)=2839\).

FINAL: 2026-07-29; 4010; 2839
